hero.desc: Digitizing intersections using AI object detection models and edge computing architecture. Automatically calculating PCU load to allocate the most optimal green light cycle.

workflow.title: Seamless Processing Pipeline
workflow.desc: From on-site cameras to hardware control modules, the system operates synchronously with ultra-low latency.
workflow.step1_desc: Traffic video is continuously recorded from IP Cameras at the intersection.
workflow.step2_desc: Object detection, tracking, and mapping against virtual routing grids.
workflow.step3_desc: Converting PCU load and applying clamping functions to distribute green time.
workflow.step4_desc: Transmitting commands to the board to execute real-time phase switching.

features.desc: Provides a comprehensive overview of traffic conditions, allowing engineers to monitor both light signals and embedded hardware performance.
features.feat1_desc: Stable 2-way configuration transmission between Edge Node and Dashboard.
features.feat2_desc: Optimizing MCU resources, preventing bottlenecks while waiting for AI threads.
features.feat3_desc: The system updates traffic light phases for the next cycle almost instantly.
